description: This file defines the SiloLifecycleSubject class, which manages lifecycle stages for a silo in Orleans. It handles logging, monitoring, and state transitions for stages like start and stop, involving observers and performance measurement.

classes.name: SiloLifecycleSubject
classes.description: A class that manages lifecycle stages of a silo, with logging and observer monitoring.

classes.name: SiloLifecycleSubject.MonitoredObserver
classes.description: A nested class that wraps an observer to add logging and performance measurement.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the lifecycle, logs stages progress.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a stage based on its integer identifier.

methods.name: PerfMeasureOnStop
methods.description: Logs performance metrics when stopping a stage.

methods.name: PerfMeasureOnStart
methods.description: Logs performance metrics when starting a stage.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds an observer to the lifecycle monitoring system.
